title: Functions with TypeScript
overview: TypeScript allows developers to define types for function parameters and return values. This helps prevent incorrect data from being passed into functions.

example.title: Function Type Example

title: Typing Function Parameters
overview: Function parameters can have specific types to ensure that functions receive the correct type of values.

title: Function Return Types
overview: Return types define what type of value a function will return. TypeScript can infer return types, but developers can also specify them manually.

title: Optional Parameters
overview: Optional parameters allow a function argument to be omitted. They are defined by adding a question mark after the parameter name.

title: Default Parameters
overview: Default parameters provide a default value when an argument is not passed to a function.

title: Arrow Functions in TypeScript
overview: Arrow functions can also use TypeScript types for parameters and return values. They are commonly used in React Native components.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how to use TypeScript with functions, including parameter types, return types, optional parameters, default values, and arrow functions.
